text:
oncall-bot: Paging: p99 spike observed for /v1/stream/generate (prod-us-west) — auto-alert triggered at 03:12 UTC. p95/p99 breached SLOs. Escalate to eng-oncall. :rotating_light:
alex.s: on it, looking at dashboards now. which model + kernel set?
maria.g: streaming tail spikes start ~03:11. p95 from ~120ms -> 480ms, p99 from ~360ms -> 2600ms. requests with long context get stalls.
derek.i: saw a compile rollout earlier this morning that changed compile flags for kernel pipeline: we flipped +FLASHATTN_OPT and a new TRT patch. hash: cb7f4a2.
alex.s: can you confirm the exact flag? Derek, pinging the build CI logs.
derek.i: flag is "-DFAST_KV_PREFETCH=1" plus FlashAttn v2.1.3 -> v2.2.0. build job: infra-kernels/ci/3421.
maria.g: correlation: traffic to canary machines (kernel-202) looks fine. but nodes built with cb7f4a2 show 10-20x tail latencies.
infra-bot: deploybot: build cb7f4a2 promoted to prod pool at 02:58 UTC via rollout policy 'default/gradual-4'.
samira: customer-impact note: CS tickets mounting — CS-4219, CS-4221, CS-4227 — customers reporting streaming stalls and partial responses. they flagged high priority.
jon`: adding logs from one affected worker:
```
[03:12:14] model=redwood-7b seq=2048 decode_time=2.54s stage=kv_fetch
[03:12:14] kernel=compilepath_v3 cb_hash=cb7f4a2 tail_wait=2200ms
[03:12:15] stall_detected count=1 last_token_delay=1800ms
```

alex.s: ok root-cause hypothesis: new compilepath + FAST_KV prefetch interacts badly with long-context streaming path => eviction/blocking in decode loop. could be memory ordering or a missed prefetch fallback.
maria.g: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback cb7f4a2, 2) disable FAST_KV at runtime if hotpatchable, 3) route streaming traffic to older kernel pool (canary) until fix.
derek.i: runtime toggle exists behind env KERNEL_FAST_KV=1 but needs host restart for kernel modules. rollback is safest short-term.
alex.s: can we divert streaming routes? routing service can failover model route to dedicated pool kernel-201 (older). need approval to shift 20% -> 100% gradually.
infra-bot: routing: current weights prod-us-west: kernel-202=80%, kernel-201=20%.
samira: prefer to move 50% first to reduce impact on customers, alert CS and devx.
jon`: adding a quick command sequence to roll back kernel build on hosts (for ops):
```
# mark bad build as unpreferred
rbctl set-build-priority cb7f4a2 0
# promote fallback
rbctl promote-build a9d3f11 --target prod-us-west --percent 50
# watch logs
rbctl tail logs --service decode --since 10m
```

alex.s: Maria, can you coordinate with CS on messages? Samira, please prepare a brief customer-facing note recommending retry/backoff for streaming sessions.
maria.g: sending CS template now, including known issue, ETA: 30-45m for partial rollback.
derek.i: starting rollback plan: building fallback artifact a9d3f11 is already available. kicking rollback job. CI job id: infra-kernels/ci/3389.
infra-bot: deploybot: rollback job infra-kernels/ci/3389 queued. estimated 7m to canary, 20m to full prod if green.
jon`: while rollback runs, let's gather metrics to confirm recovery targets: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 600ms, streaming stall rate < 2x baseline. starting a Prom query monitor.
alex.s: enabling extra stash for KV cache in the interim on canary to reduce stall amplification: set ENV KV_CACHE_FILL=aggressive on canary hosts only.
derek.i: note: KV cache change is low-risk and reversible. applying to kernel-201 hosts now.
infra-bot: ops: KV cache env applied to kernel-201 hosts.
maria.g: CS updated customers CS-4219/4221/4227 with short note and we linked to status.redwood.ai/incident/1749994321.
samira: shipping traffic to 50% on fallback now. monitoring.
infra-bot: routing: kernel-202=50%, kernel-201=50%.
jon`: early metrics after 3m: p95 -> 210ms (good), p99 -> 680ms (improving but above target), stall-rate down 3x from peak.
alex.s: keep rolling to 100% if stable. Derek keep working on a root fix; likely patch around prefetch backoff.
derek.i: starting investigation to repro locally with long-context harness. patch candidate: add backoff on hv_prefetch if kv_miss_rate > 0.1. will post PR.
infra-bot: deploybot: rollback to a9d3f11 promoted to 100% prod-us-west at 03:36 UTC.
jon`: post-rollback metrics at 03:40: p95=190ms, p99=320ms, streaming stall count back to baseline.
maria.g: CS: updated customers, tickets marked escalation resolved pending further validation.
samira: raising follow-up runbook task: add canary watch for any compilepath-related flags in future rollouts and require 1hr canary with streaming-load smoke tests.
alex.s: agreed. adding to eng-runtime backlog: RN-1258 "Require streaming smoke for compilepath-rollouts".
derek.i: PR opened with safer prefetch backoff and test harness attached: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5621. adding stress test results.
alex.s: handoff to oncall-ops: if any regression reappears reopen paging and ping ENG oncall. otherwise closing this thread. thanks all. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident resolved (monitoring stable). Incident ticket INC-1749994321 created for postmortem.
notes: post-incident: retro scheduled 24h. follow-ups assigned to eng-runtime and infra.
